verses.1: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
verses.2: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
verses.3: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
verses.4: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.5: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
verses.6: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
verses.7: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.8: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
